[Thundering Fury Dadao](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3166)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 75

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 1

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

This massive, curved blade roars when it crashes down on opponents, seemingly intent on subduing them with sheer force. It's said materials for the first thundering fury dadaos came from the hide of Yorak, the Horned Thunder, a legendary kaiju that roams the Shanguang desert. The lack of embellishments on this _+2 striking [thundering](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2850) [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=379)_ belies a weapon of deadly efficacy. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You infuse the _thundering fury dadao_ with the speed of lightning and the force of thunder. The weapon gains the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526) and [forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=611) traits for one round. You can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) this activation for up to 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">
